text: Entry Requirements High-school graduate (or above) who is qualified to apply to universities. Be a non-Chinese citizon holding a valid ordinary (private) passport and agree to observe the laws of China and the regulations of BUCT. Aged between 18 to 25; Applicants under 18 must provide certificate of guardian who has Beijing residency. Applicants with Chinese background must comply with the regulation (Jw/ 2020]No.12) issued by Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. IELTS score ≥6.0/TOEFL score≥85, or other equivalent language proficiency certificate recognized by the university. CSCA requirements download here .
